title: 第七章 苏阎 我给你选择第八章 麻烦上门了
content_zh:
练，是死路一条。
不练，同样是死路一条。
这是个死结。
石室里安静得可怕。
苏阎冷静下来，重新坐回石床。
他调出那道只有自己能看见的透明面板。
【姓名：苏阎】
【修为：练气一层】
【寿元：八年五十日】
【天赋：掠夺奇才】
【功法：阴阳赋（残缺）造化天诀（残缺）】
目光落在最后一行。
面板已经将《造化天诀》收录进去了。
当务之急，还是必须先尽快的提升实力。
只有实力强大到对方无法对自己造成威胁才能够在这宗门中活下来。
《造化天诀》短时间内是肯定不能修炼的了，但又要提升实力，目前也就只有依靠《阴阳赋》。
《阴阳赋》的修炼法门，说白了就四个字，采补阴阳。
男修以阳炼阴，女修以阴养阳。
双方气血交融，互为根基，才能将功法真正的运转起来。
缺少了一方，修炼之时法力在经脉中容易失去平衡，轻则走火入魔，重则经脉尽断，七窍流血而死。

这也是为什么李言要特意提醒他挑选鼎炉的原因。
那个笑面虎什么都算到了。
不过眼下，苏阎也没有更好的选择。
残缺归残缺，好歹能让他从炼气一层往上走。
想到这，苏阎将目光看向了角落中的少女。
“你叫什么名字？”
声音不大，在空荡荡的石室里却格外清冷。
少女的身子猛地一缩，两只手下意识的往身前交叉护住胸口。
她不敢不答，今天这一整天发生的事早已把她吓坏，先是王管事那张猪脸凑过来时的恶臭，再到那根骨头刺穿喉咙时飞溅的热血。
她亲眼看见了苏阎是怎么杀人的。
干净，利落，连眼睛都没眨一下。
“林……林安。”
苏阎从石床上站起来，走到她面前。
林安把脑袋埋得更低了，整个人剧烈的抖动，呼吸急促而紊乱，鼻腔里还残存着哭过之后的鼻音。
“抬起头来。”
林安咬了咬下唇，慢慢把脸抬起来。
泪痕和泥污混在一起，糊了大半张脸。
content_en:
Practicing is a dead end.
Without practice, it is also a dead end.
This is a dead end.
The stone room was eerily quiet.
Su Yan calmed down and sat back on the stone bed.
He brought up the transparent panel that only he could see.
[Name: Su Yan]
[Cultivation: Level 1 of Qi training]
[Shouyuan: eight years and fifty days]
[Talent: Plunder Wizards]
[Kung Fu: Yin and Yang Fu (Incomplete) and the Art of Creation (Incomplete)]
My eyes fell on the last line.
The panel has already included "The Secret of Creation".
The most urgent task is to improve the strength as soon as possible.
Only those who are so strong that the opponent cannot pose a threat to themselves can survive in this sect.
"The Art of Creation" will definitely not be practiced in a short period of time, but if you want to improve your strength, you can only rely on "Yin Yang Fu" at the moment.
The cultivation method of "Yin Yang Fu" can be put simply in four words, which is to replenish yin and yang.
Male practitioners use yang to refine yin, while female practitioners use yin to nourish yang.
Only when the Qi and blood of both parties blend and form each other's foundation can the practice truly operate.
If one of them is missing, the magic power in the meridians will easily lose balance during practice, and the person may go crazy and become possessed, or in the worst case, the meridians may be severed and the seven orifices may bleed to death.
This is why Li Yan specially reminded him to choose the cauldron.
That smiling tiger has figured it all out.
But right now, Su Yan has no better choice.
The incompleteness is still incomplete, but it can at least allow him to move up from the level of Qi refining.
Thinking of this, Su Yan looked at the girl in the corner.
"What's your name?"
The sound was not loud, but it was particularly cold in the empty stone room.
The girl's body shrank suddenly, and her hands subconsciously crossed in front of her to protect her chest.
She didn't dare not answer. What happened throughout the day had already frightened her. First, the stench when Manager Wang's pig face approached her, and then the hot blood splashing when the bone pierced her throat.
She saw with her own eyes how Su Yan killed people.
Clean, neat, without even blinking an eye.
"Lin...Lin An."
Su Yan stood up from the stone bed and walked to her.
Lin An buried his head even lower, his whole body was shaking violently, his breathing was rapid and disordered, and there was still a nasal sound in his nasal cavity after crying.
"Keep your head up."
Lin An bit his lower lip and slowly raised his face.
Tears and mud mixed together, covering most of his face.
